decisions.reason: As a web-based utility that is very close to our existing software and API capabilities, it is easy for us to understand, maintain and refine even if demand is only moderate.
This Austria-specific regulatory database is a narrow niche with continuous update needs and is less tightly connected to our core German software and consultancy knowledge base.
The service likely builds on energy-sector analytical know-how that we can reuse across client work, giving us enough related knowledge to keep learning and improving it.
A tariff database fits reasonably well with data-driven energy applications and can benefit from feedback and reuse in customer projects, though it does require ongoing data maintenance.
Custom web services sit directly in our core competence as a medium-sized programming and consultancy firm, so our absorptive capacity for improving and selling them is strongest here.
A postal code lookup service is a simple adjacent web product that complements our existing technical knowledge and can be kept at relatively low development and support cost.
